column1: #pval_chi2q_multiGroup: P-value of the chi-square test for all pharmacological subtype
#pval_chi2q_2Group: P-value of the chi-square test for the pharmacological subtype sensitive and resistant groups
#nodes.category_median_low2high.: Nodes of the drug pharmacology classification tree (sorted by median of category in ascending order)
#ratios.category_median_low2high.: Mutation ratios of the drug pharmacology classification tree (sorted by median of category in ascending order)
#resistant_num: Number of drug-resistant nodes(number of drug-resistant pharmacological subtypes)
#pval_chi2q_eachTwoGroup: The p-value of the chi-square test for each of the two pharmacological subtypes
#correlation_trend: Increasing ratio of mutations is negative, decreasing is positive
#direction: Direction of drug and gene connection
#dir_corr: Pearson Correlation of mutation ratios and incremental sequences
#dir_p: Pearson correlation p-values of mutation proportions and incremental sequences
#sensi_p: Pearson correlation p-values for the ratio of mutations in the sensitive group to the incremental sequence
#sensi_corr: Pearson correlation between the ratio of mutations in sensitive groups and incremental sequences
#sensi_trend:  The proportion of mutations in the sensitive group increased as negative and decreased as positive
#padj_chi2q_2Group: Adjusted p-value of the chi-square test for the pharmacological subtype sensitive and resistant groups
#padj_chi2q_multiGroup: Adjusted p-value of the chi-square test for all pharmacological subtype
